description: Flask-based employee/admin management web application running on localhost:5003. Multi-role authentication system with employee and admin roles. Database-backed user management with SQLite.

endpoints: GET /admin/dashboard - Admin dashboard (requires authentication, has flag exposure)
GET /logout - Logout endpoint (has bug when no session)

notes: Application serves employee/admin portal with multi-role access control. Contains hardcoded default credentials (emp/emppassword, admin/Q&(GHD)*!X#BY). Flag is exposed in admin dashboard HTML via flag attribute. 2FA uses hardcoded code '1234'. Debug mode enabled in production. Source code accessible via error messages.
